name: io.github.AmirhosseinHanifehzadeh/aio-tests-mcp
title: AIO Tests
description: Test management in Jira via AIO Tests: search, read, create and update test cases, browse folders and tags. Supports Jira Cloud and Server/Data Center.

environmentVariables.name: AIO_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: AIO Tests access token, generated in Jira under AIO Tests > (?) icon > API Access Token. Required for Jira Cloud; setting it alone enables the server.

environmentVariables.name: AIO_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to enable Jira Server/Data Center mode, where the AIO Tests API is served from your Jira base URL.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Jira base URL, for Server/Data Center deployments.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_PERSONAL_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Jira Personal Access Token, for Server/Data Center deployments.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Jira username, for Server/Data Center basic authentication. Use together with JIRA_API_TOKEN, as an alternative to JIRA_PERSONAL_TOKEN.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Jira password or API token, paired with JIRA_USERNAME for Server/Data Center basic authentication.

environmentVariables.name: AIO_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the AIO Tests API base URL. Defaults to the AIO Tests Cloud API, or {JIRA_URL}/rest/aio-tcms-api/1.0 on Server/Data Center.

environmentVariables.name: AIO_SSL_VERIFY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'false' to skip TLS certificate verification, for a Server/Data Center instance behind a self-signed certificate. Testing only.

environmentVariables.name: READ_ONLY_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to hide every write tool, so the model can read test data but never modify it.

environmentVariables.name: ENABLED_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowlist of tool names to expose. Defaults to all tools.
